# FTR — First Time Resolver

> IT services company in Gurugram serving businesses across India with IT infrastructure sourcing, systems integration, facility management and annual maintenance contracts (AMC) since 2010.

FTR (First Time Resolver Pvt. Ltd.) brings together IT sales, hardware and software integration and ongoing support. We start with business needs and build dependable solutions across hardware, software, networking and workplace technology.

## Solutions

- [IT Infrastructure & Sourcing](https://ftrgroup.in/#services): Computers, laptops, servers, network switches, peripherals and global materials sourcing.
- [Systems Integration](https://ftrgroup.in/#services): Connect platforms, applications and data into a cohesive environment. Architecture and solution design, and application development.
- [Facility Management Services](https://ftrgroup.in/#services): Server, network and desktop support, IT asset management and surveillance management.
- [Annual Maintenance Contracts](https://ftrgroup.in/#services): Comprehensive coverage, IT hardware troubleshooting, and operating system and application support.

## Company

- [About FTR](https://ftrgroup.in/#about): One partner for IT sales, integration and ongoing support across India.
- [How we work](https://ftrgroup.in/#approach): Understand, find the right fit, build and integrate, then support and maintain.
- [Our journey since 2010](https://ftrgroup.in/#journey): Established in NCR in 2010; pan-India sales and services since 2016.
- [Clients we’ve worked with](https://ftrgroup.in/#partners): Hero Cycles, LAVA, Ahresty, BANDO, Dixon, MINDA, Sunwoda, Bellsonica, Tenon, Lucas TVS, UFI Filters and TresVista.
